note: RI Gen. Laws Title 23 Ch.23-64.1 (Commission for Health Advocacy and Equity) S23-64.1-2 only DEFINES "community health worker" for the Commission's own purposes -- no chapter establishes individual CHW certification/registration/scope of practice. Medicaid CHW reimbursement runs through EOHHS administrative policy, not a General Laws section. Certification is run entirely by the private Rhode Island Certification Board with no statutory enabling authority. (2026-07-09, tier3_absence Step 2 follow-up).
